name: Yoshikawa Machiko
source:
Yoshikawa Machiko is the twin sister of [url=/c56546]Yoshikawa Kyouko[/url] and co-owner of owner of the info shop in Kathtom with her sister.
Unlike Kyouko, who dedicates her studies towards fortune telling, Machiko believes technology is the future and she even somewhat talks like a machine.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Machiko_Yoshikawa]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
